quiz.intro.2: Good. Don't be afraid. You are about to wake up in a world that is not yours.
quiz.intro.3: First, answer me honestly. Your answers will tell who you really are.
quiz.q.lantern: You are walking at night and your lantern suddenly goes out. What do you do?
quiz.q.lantern.a1: I keep going in the dark.
quiz.q.lantern.a3: I laugh. Someone must be playing a trick on me.
quiz.q.mask: Someone offers you a mask that gives you anyone's face. Do you take it?
quiz.q.mask.a1: Yes, and I'll use it to play pranks.
quiz.q.mask.a2: No. I like being who I am.
quiz.q.mask.a3: Yes, so nobody ever recognises me again.
quiz.q.friend: Someone you love is crying and won't tell you why. What do you do?
quiz.q.friend.a1: I sit beside them without a word.
quiz.q.friend.a2: I tease them until they laugh.
quiz.q.friend.a3: I go after whoever hurt them.
quiz.q.mirror: In an old mirror, your reflection moves a second late. What do you do?
quiz.q.mirror.a1: I stick my tongue out at it and see what it does.
quiz.q.mirror.a2: I back away slowly and never look again.
quiz.q.mirror.a3: I wave. Maybe it wants to play.
quiz.q.storm: A storm traps you in a cabin with strangers. What do you do?
quiz.q.storm.a1: I set up shifts to watch the door.
quiz.q.storm.a2: I tell ghost stories to liven up the night.
quiz.q.storm.a3: I find a quiet corner and wait it out.
quiz.q.keepsake: You find something that belonged to someone who is gone. What do you do?
quiz.q.keepsake.a1: I keep it and carry it with me always.
quiz.q.keepsake.a2: I leave it where it was. It isn't mine.
quiz.q.keepsake.a3: I try it on to see how it looks on me.
quiz.q.voice: Someone calls your name from a dark corridor. What do you do?
quiz.q.voice.a2: I pretend I didn't hear anything.
quiz.q.voice.a3: I walk towards the voice. I'm curious.
quiz.q.wish: If you could make one wish tonight, what would it be?
quiz.q.wish.a1: That nobody would ever feel alone again.
quiz.q.wish.a3: That the world were a little stranger.
quiz.nature.brave.text: You don't run when things turn ugly. You stand your ground, even with shaking legs.
quiz.nature.calm.text: You listen before you act. Your calm is a small light that guides others through the dark.
quiz.nature.hardy.text: You carry whatever must be carried without complaint. What you lose, you keep with you.
quiz.nature.jolly.text: Even on the blackest night you find something to laugh about, and your laughter spreads.
quiz.nature.lonely.text: You hide from others, but deep down you only want someone to love you as you are.
quiz.nature.quirky.text: Nobody ever knows what you'll do next. Not even you. And you love it.
quiz.nature.sassy.text: You say what you think and poke fun at anyone who takes things too seriously.
quiz.nature.timid.text: You startle easily, but you see danger before anyone else.

passive.disguise.description: The first hit you take in each room deals no damage and breaks the disguise.
move.fury-swipes.description: Five quick scratches in front of you; the last one hits hard. Normal: barely hurts Ghosts (Gastly, Aegislash).
move.feint-attack.description: A swift feint: you dart through the enemy and end up behind it, facing it. Fast and free.
move.night-daze.description: A dark wave around you that hits everyone. Hold to charge.
move.foul-play.description: A charged lunge; deals more damage if the enemy is attacking.
move.ember.description: A small, fast flame at range. Free.
move.astonish.description: A point-blank scare that staggers and pushes the enemy away.
move.hex.description: A slow wisp; double damage if the enemy is staggered. Hold to charge.
move.inferno.description: A big, very slow and very strong fireball. Hold to charge.
move.bone-club.description: A short bone swing that staggers hard.
move.bone-rush.description: Three bone blows while you advance; the last one hits hard.
move.bonemerang.description: You throw the bone: it flies out, comes back to you and you catch it; it hits on both passes. Hold to charge.
move.stomping-tantrum.description: A charged stomp all around; twice as strong if your previous attack missed.
move.swords-dance.description: A frenetic dance: your next 3 hits deal 50% more damage (9 s).
move.nasty-plot.description: Plots something nasty: faster and more critical hits for 5 s.
move.will-o-wisp.description: Ghostly flames: lights Flash Fire at once; your next heavy move is powered up.
move.bulk-up.description: Tenses its muscles: takes 40% less damage for 6 s.
move.dazzling-gleam.description: A flash all around you that hits everyone close.
move.shadow-force.description: A slow, brutal strike from the shadows: a wide cone in front.
move.dark-pulse.description: A sinister ring wave that clears whoever surrounds you.
move.snarl.description: A furious yell in a very wide cone; quick to throw, less power.
move.flamethrower.description: A straight blast of flame that goes through every enemy in its line.
move.heat-wave.description: A scorching gust in a wide cone in front of you.
move.earthquake.description: You shake the ground: a huge, strong ring, but slow to come out.
move.bulldoze.description: A stomp that shakes the ground around you; quick and short.
passive.illusion.description: You enter each floor disguised: sleeping enemies do not notice you until you touch them, and your first hit is critical.
passive.flash-fire.description: Fire-type attacks do not hurt you: they heal you a little and power up your next heavy move. Nobody in the Crypt attacks with Fire, so your own flames stoke it: every 4 Fire hits power up your next heavy move.
passive.battle-armor.description: While you charge or wind up a heavy move, hits from the front deal half damage.

menu.controls.gamepad: Controller: left stick to move, A to roll, X fast, Y heavy (hold to charge), LB boost, RB area, right stick to aim, LT or R3 to lock, D-pad sides to switch target, Start menu, Back minimap. In menus: A confirm, B back; X, Y and RB pick an item.

menu.controls.heavy: Right click or E: heavy move (hold to charge; the click aims at the cursor, E where you face)
menu.controls.boost: R or 1: boost (a self-buff on a cooldown; no stamina)
menu.controls.area: F or 2: area move (cone, ring or wave; cooldown and stamina)
menu.controls.lock: Shift or middle click: lock onto the enemy nearest the cursor (press or hold, per the lock type); wheel: switch target
menu.controls.clickLock: Left click on an enemy: lock onto it (when enabled; it also attacks)
menu.controls.menu: Esc: menu (pause, quick settings, restart floor, quit)

prologue.light.1: There was a time when the sun knew no shadow.
prologue.light.2: Pokémon lived in its shelter, and wanted for nothing.
prologue.hunger.1: But beneath the earth, something woke up hungry.
prologue.hunger.2: It sought neither flesh nor land. It sought the light.
prologue.dimming.1: It drank from the sun, day after day, until the sun was hollow.
prologue.dimming.2: The sky went out like an ember no one tends.
prologue.eclipse.1: And then came the Crimson Eclipse.
prologue.eclipse.2: A red ring over nothing. It has not moved since.
prologue.dungeons.1: With it, the Shadow Dungeons opened:
prologue.dungeons.2: mouths of stone that were not there the day before.
prologue.shadows.1: Many went in to find what had been lost.
prologue.shadows.2: Those who came back were no longer themselves. Only their shadows.
prologue.guardians.1: Every dungeon has its guardian, bound by an oath that no one remembers.
prologue.guardians.2: And deeper than them all, something is still devouring the light.
prologue.voice.1: …Do you hear me? Can you hear me?
dungeon.crypt.name: Crypt of the Sword King
dungeon.crypt.subtitle: Where steel still awaits its orders
dungeon.crypt.lore.1: In the depths of the crypt, the Sword King guards a sealed door.
dungeon.crypt.lore.2: No one knows whether he shields the world from what lies behind it, or what lies behind it from the world.
town.beacon.1: A cold flame burns in the stone. Whoever stokes it calls other explorers to an online room.
town.beacon.room: The flame already burns for your room. Esc opens the room menu.
town.gacha.1: Did you come to play with me? Every capsule brings someone new, and I want lots of friends.
town.gacha.after.1: It's you! You turn around before I ask. That's why you get to pull first.
town.shop.1: Since the Crimson Eclipse the forge will not light by itself. Bring me what you find below and I will make you stronger.
town.story.1: There was a sun that knew no shadow. Now only that red ring remains: the Crimson Eclipse.
town.story.2: With the eclipse the Shadow Dungeons opened. Those who come back are not themselves. Only their shadow.
town.story.3: Every dungeon has its guardian, bound to an oath no one remembers. The Sword King is only the first.
town.story.4: And deeper than all of them, something is still devouring the light. No one has seen its face.
town.resident.abra.2: …zzz… the blanket isn't mine… they left it at my door… zzz…
town.resident.abra.after.1: …Is that you? Then I'll keep sleeping. Sit down, if you like. I won't go anywhere.
town.resident.abra.after.2: Zzz… thanks for not leaving… zzz…
town.resident.zorua.after.1: …You know who I am. Don't say it out loud. Not yet.
town.resident.zorua.revealed.1: It's me. Just me. I'm saying it in my own voice. Pretty good, right?
town.resident.axew.1: I'm training. Alone. The elders left, so I'm making myself strong.
town.resident.axew.2: The marks on this tree are mine. All low. Don't count them. And don't look at my teeth.
town.resident.axew.after.1: It's you. You've already seen my tusk, so I'm not hiding it.
town.resident.axew.after.2: Still training. But if you pass by, you can watch. Just watch.

town.exit.text: The road leaves town towards the dungeons.
dungeon.eclipse.name: Sima del Eclipse
dungeon.eclipse.subtitle: Where the light falls and never lands
dungeon.eclipse.lore.1: Everything that never came back from the dungeons ends up falling through here. You can come back. For now.
dungeon.eclipse.lore.2: Down there you see what others lost and what your head invents. The longer you stay, the more alike.
screen.eclipse.title: You got lost
screen.eclipse.text: Your shadow carried you up to the crater's rim. It still needs you. Your mark stays on the board.

dungeon.forest.name: Misty Forest
dungeon.forest.subtitle: Where the fog is the breath of the lost
dungeon.forest.lore.1: Those lost in the fog never return: they take root, and listen.
dungeon.forest.lore.2: In the deepest clearing, a faceless archer keeps watch over a door no one has seen open.
spell.decidueye.dive: Owl Sign "Dive of the Hollow Moon"
guardian.decidueye.title: The Archer of the Fog
guardian.decidueye.pre.1: The fog has led you to the clearing. Here the paths end.
guardian.decidueye.pre.2: I have watched this door since the sun went out. No one crosses while I have an arrow left.
guardian.decidueye.post.1: My oath was a drawn bowstring. At last it rests.
guardian.decidueye.post.2: Beneath the roots, something still drinks the light. I hear it breathing in the fog.
dungeon.forest.floor.1: The mist is young here; the trees still remember names.
dungeon.forest.floor.2: Here the pumpkins laugh alone when no one walks by.
dungeon.forest.floor.3: The paths move while you sleep.
dungeon.forest.floor.4: The hollow trunk listens. Something inside learned to hate.
dungeon.forest.floor.5: Under the moss, the roots drink from those who gave up.
dungeon.forest.floor.6: Wandering lights guide those who know how to ask forgiveness.
dungeon.forest.floor.7: The mist is no longer breath: it is a choir of lost voices.
dungeon.forest.floor.8: The deepest clearing. A taut string waits in the dark.
forest.wisp.appear: A wandering light beckons between the trees.
forest.wisp.found: The light settles over a hidden cache of berries.
spell.trevenant.roots: Root Sign «Paths of the Hungry Root»
spell.trevenant.spiral: Leaf Sign «Spiral of the Weeping Wood»
spell.trevenant.grove: Grove Sign «Dance of the Thousand Branches»
spell.decidueye.mist: The Archer fades into the mist
spell.decidueye.stitch: Shadow Sign «Stitch of the Twin Shadows»
guardian.aegislash.title: The Sword King
guardian.aegislash.pre.1: I am the first of those who keep watch. No shadow passes this door.
guardian.aegislash.pre.2: Draw, little one. Let steel say who goes on.
guardian.aegislash.post.1: The oath breaks… but this was not the only door.
guardian.aegislash.post.2: Beyond, other guardians wait. And deeper still, the light keeps falling.

dungeon.crypt.floor.1: The halls smell of wax and old iron.
dungeon.crypt.floor.2: Here rest those who swore. Some do not rest.
dungeon.crypt.floor.3: The king's treasury. Something glints, and it is not gold.
dungeon.crypt.floor.4: Fallen swords still rise as you pass.
dungeon.crypt.floor.5: The air trembles. Further down, the steel is waiting.
dungeon.crypt.floor.6: The throne room. Kneel, or draw.

world.sima.name: Sima del Eclipse
world.sealed.locked: A red seal bars the way. It will break when the guardian of {dungeon} falls.
world.sealed.missing: Something blocks the way. You cannot go down here.
world.npc.fisher.1: Nothing has bitten since the eclipse. Only shadows. I keep the hole by the pier open and keep casting anyway: someone has to.
world.npc.fisher.2: The lake no longer mirrors the sky. It mirrors what lies beneath. Don't lean over too far.
world.npc.fisher.after.1: It's you. Sit on the pier. If someone comes up through the hole, better there are two of us watching.
world.npc.keeper.1: This hamlet lived off the lake's light. When the sun went out, the lake froze over, and the ice is black: there is no light left beneath it.
world.npc.keeper.2: My flame is small, but it does not go out. Those lost in the fog follow it here.
world.npc.keeper.3: Lookout Pass joins the two villages. Mind the rift: the bridge is the only thing still standing.
world.npc.keeper.4: They say that in the northern crater the eclipse is so close you can hear it. A hum, like a heart.
world.npc.keeper.after.1: It's you. Stay one step away, like that night. That way the flame doesn't ask to eat. Or asks less.
town.resident.piplup.1: A berry? No. I don't need anything. Not from you, not from anyone.
town.resident.piplup.2: This hole is the only one left down to the water. I watch it because I want to. I'm not waiting for anyone. Let's be clear.
town.resident.piplup.after.1: It's you. …Fine. Leave the berry there, by the hole. I won't take it from your hand. That's different.
world.npc.oracle.2: Beyond the lake lie lands that have no name yet. Some day the road will go on.
town.resident.shinx.1: I watch where you all go down. Someone has to remember which way each one went.
town.resident.shinx.2: My sparks don't reach the bottom. Doesn't matter. I keep watching.
town.resident.shinx.after.1: It's you. I saw you go down and I saw you come up. I'm writing it down. So I know it can be done.
world.lore.knight.name: Faceless statue
world.lore.knight.1: A faceless stone knight. At its feet: "Who swore by the sword shall never let it go."
world.lore.knight.2: The inscription has changed. Now it reads: "Rest, Sword King. Your oath is over."
world.lore.knight.3: Someone has left an owl feather at its feet. It is still warm.
world.lore.sign.name: Road sign
world.lore.sign.1: West: Dusk Haven. East: Lookout Pass. North, the crypt. Do not go down alone.
world.lore.sign.2: Someone has crossed out "Do not go down alone" and written below: "One came back."
world.lore.view.name: Lookout
world.lore.view.1: From here the whole Crimson Eclipse is in sight. Every night it seems a little closer.
world.lore.view.2: To the south, the forest's fog moves as if it were breathing.
world.lore.view.3: At last you can see the bottom of the crater to the north. Something red beats down there, in time with the eclipse.
world.lore.crater.name: Burnt statue
world.lore.crater.1: A statue stares into the depths of the Sima. Its hands are burnt, as if it had tried to hold the sun.
world.lore.crater.2: Carved on the base: "The first guardian fell. The others have felt it."
world.lore.crater.3: A fresh carving, no moss on it yet: "The Sima has no bottom. Only more eclipse."
world.lore.idol.name: Lake idol
world.lore.idol.1: A moss-covered frog idol. The lake folk leave it offerings so the water stays still.
world.lore.idol.2: There is a new offering: a broken sword, its hilt turned towards the lake.
world.lore.idol.3: For an instant, the water by the idol mirrors a sun that no longer exists.
lobby.hostOnly: Only the room's host can lead the group into a dungeon.

difficulty.easy.hint: The game as it always was. Unlimited floor restarts.
difficulty.normal.hint: Somewhat tougher, keener enemies, the odd elite. Pays ×1.3.
difficulty.hard.hint: New attacks and longer combos, more elites, 1 restart per floor. Pays ×1.7.
difficulty.nightmare.hint: Extra spell cards and frequent elites, no restarts. Pays ×2.2.
dungeon.caves.name: Flooded Caves
dungeon.caves.subtitle: Where the drowned bell still calls its own
dungeon.caves.lore.1: Under the Black Lake sleeps a sunken shrine; its bell rings at every eclipse.
dungeon.caves.lore.2: They say an anchor with no ship keeps the deep, bound to an oath nobody remembers.
dungeon.caves.floor.1: Water drips from a sky of stone. Every drop sounds like a distant bell.
dungeon.caves.floor.2: The crystals keep the last light that fell here. Something is drinking it.
dungeon.caves.floor.3: Ship's ropes float in the pools. No ship ever came this deep.
dungeon.caves.floor.4: The water reaches your ankles. Further down, something pulls at it.
dungeon.caves.floor.5: A grotto of blue light. That lantern is not there to guide you.
dungeon.caves.floor.6: Past the lantern, the only light left is the one you bring.
dungeon.caves.floor.7: The walls weep salt. Sailors swore oaths here and never came back.
dungeon.caves.floor.8: The bell rings closer, and no current moves it.
dungeon.caves.floor.9: The water is warm, as if something huge were breathing below.
dungeon.caves.floor.10: The wreck. An anchor keeps watch over a crew that sank with its oath.
spell.lanturn.bubbles: Bubble Sign "Rings of the Silent Deep"
spell.dhelmise.undertow: Anchor Sign "Undertow of the Drowned Bell"
spell.dhelmise.riptide: Phantom Sign "Current Rising from the Wreck"
spell.dhelmise.bell: Bell Sign "Toll of the Sunken Oaths"
guardian.dhelmise.title: The Anchor of the Sunken Oaths
guardian.dhelmise.pre.1: The bell has led you to the wreck. Here the water lets no one go back.
guardian.dhelmise.pre.2: I swore to keep those who sank with me. Nobody remembers the oath now, but the anchor does.
guardian.dhelmise.post.1: The chain comes loose. At last I can go down with them.
guardian.dhelmise.post.2: Deeper than the deep, something swallows the light. The bell was ringing to warn you.
dungeon.swamp.name: Toxic Swamp
dungeon.swamp.subtitle: Where the eclipse light dripped from another sky
dungeon.swamp.lore.1: The first drop of the red light fell here. The water drank it, and turned to poison.
dungeon.swamp.lore.2: At the heart of the swamp, something not of this world floats above a tear in the sky.
dungeon.swamp.floor.1: The water does not reflect the sky. It reflects another one.
dungeon.swamp.floor.2: The bubbles burst with a sweet smell. Do not breathe deep.
dungeon.swamp.floor.3: The trees died standing, looking up.
dungeon.swamp.floor.4: The spores glow like stars that fell into the wrong sky.
dungeon.swamp.floor.5: It smells of sweet smoke. The queen of the swamp already knows you are here.
dungeon.swamp.floor.6: Past the den, the mud whispers in a tongue without words.
dungeon.swamp.floor.7: Something beats under the mire, slowly, like a stranger's heart.
dungeon.swamp.floor.8: The stones are cold and smooth, like glass fallen from above.
dungeon.swamp.floor.9: The air hums. The wound in the sky is close.
dungeon.swamp.floor.10: Beneath the wound in the sky, something waits for you, and it has no face.
world.npc.hermit.1: Croak… Do not step in the black water. It does not wet: it bites.
world.npc.hermit.2: The night the sun went out, a drop of red light fell right here. The swamp has not slept since.
world.npc.hermit.3: Something floats over the rift, at the bottom of the swamp. It is not from here. I think it is not even from this sky.
world.lore.crystal.name: Fallen crystal
world.lore.crystal.1: A cold crystal, half sunk in the mud. It hums, as if it were listening to something very far away.
world.lore.crystal.2: Inside the crystal you can see a sky that is not this one: black, starless, crossed by a breaking light.
world.lore.crystal.3: The hum has changed. Now it sounds like a door someone is pushing from the other side.
guardian.nihilego.title: «She Who Fell Through the Rift in the Sky»
guardian.nihilego.pre.1: The water holds its breath. Above the rift, something floats without weight.
guardian.nihilego.pre.2: I come from a sunless sky. There the light shattered, and its hunger reached you.
guardian.nihilego.post.1: I fade… On the other side many more still watch through the rift.
guardian.nihilego.post.2: The light you lack was not lost. Something drinks it, beyond your sky.
sima.band.crypt.name: Stratum I · Echoes of the Crypt
sima.band.crypt.subtitle: What you know
sima.band.crypt.lore.1: The first walls still smell of the wax of the King's candles.
sima.band.crypt.lore.2: Something comes down with you. It makes no sound. It only copies you.
sima.band.crypt.lore.3: Everything looks like places you have seen. You still trust your eyes.
sima.band.crypt.lore.4: The red ring watches from above. It is still small.
sima.band.forest.name: Stratum II · Roots of the Sunken Forest
sima.band.forest.subtitle: What you fear
sima.band.forest.lore.1: Roots without a tree hang from the ceiling, reaching for a sun that is not there.
sima.band.forest.lore.2: Here it starts to feel as if something is watching you.
sima.band.forest.lore.3: The moss glows red. It is not daylight any more.
sima.band.forest.lore.4: An owl hoots very far away, or very close. Down here it is the same.
sima.band.abyss.name: Stratum V · The Abyss beneath the Ring
sima.band.abyss.subtitle: What is left of you
sima.band.abyss.lore.1: There are no walls any more. Only floating stone and the fall all around.
sima.band.abyss.lore.2: The red light rains downwards and never reaches the bottom.
sima.band.abyss.lore.3: Far off stand the towers of a kingdom that sank whole.
sima.band.abyss.lore.4: The eclipse fills half the sky. It beats.
sima.band.abyss.lore.5: The only thing holding you up is your name. Do not let go of it.
sima.log.vault.here: It smells of gold on this floor: a treasure vault, and something guards it.
sima.log.vault.opened: The chest opens! Pick an item.
sima.log.shrine.here: An eclipse altar throbs somewhere on this floor.
sima.log.shrine.accepted: The pact is sealed. The eclipse gives and the eclipse takes.
sima.log.shrine.declined: You turn your back on the altar. Its light goes out.
sima.log.monsterHouse.woke: A monster house! They all wake at once.
sima.log.crystal.here: A time crystal glows on this floor. It will not last.
sima.log.crystal.faded: The time crystal has gone out.
sima.log.merchant.here: A merchant echo waits on this floor. It takes Pokédollars.
sima.log.merchant.berry: You eat the merchant's Oran Berry.
sima.log.nest.here: Something hums between the walls: an eclipse nest.
sima.log.nest.woke: The nest wakes! Break it or it will not stop.
sima.log.nest.destroyed: The nest cracks and falls silent.
sima.log.waves.here: A room on this floor has doors that close by themselves.
sima.log.waves.start: The doors slam shut! Hold out against the waves.
sima.log.waves.cleared: The doors open. The room rewards you.
sima.log.ambush.woke: The ground cracks under your feet...
sima.log.hunter.here: Something has caught your scent. Find the stairs, fast.
sima.log.hunter.loosed: The Eclipse Hound is after you! It cannot be beaten: run.

sima.pact.blood.name: Moon Blood

sima.shrine.hint: The pact lasts this floor and the next ones, {floors} in all. 1/2 or click.
sima.shrine.hostDecides: The altar waits for the host: the pact binds the whole group.
sima.merchant.title: Merchant Echo
sima.merchant.hint: You carry {coins} P from this run. What you spend here is not paid out at the end.
sima.merchant.leaveText: The echo watches you go without a word.
sima.echo.subtitle: Floor {floor} · The shadow that came down with you
sima.echo.line.1: The eclipse gives you back a shadow shaped like {species}. Hollow and red.
sima.echo.line.2: Something has come down with you from the start: the echo of {species}, made of what you left behind.
sima.echo.line.3: The echo of {species} no longer mimics: it remembers. Every floor makes it more yours.

sima.band.caves.name: Stratum III · The Drowned Bell
sima.band.caves.subtitle: What you name
sima.band.caves.lore.1: Water runs up the walls here, towards the eclipse.
sima.band.caves.lore.2: The bell of the wreck rings below you. Or above.
sima.band.caves.lore.3: What cannot be understood, the mind gives a name. Here it starts doing so.
sima.band.caves.lore.4: An anchor chain hangs into the dark and pulls at nothing.
sima.band.swamp.name: Stratum IV · The Poisoned Sky
sima.band.swamp.subtitle: What is not yours
sima.band.swamp.lore.1: The water does not reflect this sky. It reflects the other one.
sima.band.swamp.lore.2: You no longer see your own fears. You see those of the ones who came down before.
sima.band.swamp.lore.3: Dead trees grow downwards, towards the eclipse.
sima.band.swamp.lore.4: A tear in the sky drips here. Something is watching through it.

shrine.title: Sanctum of Oaths
shrine.subtitle: Where the guardians swear again
shrine.text: Every guardian that falls leaves its oath here. Touch it and it will keep it once more.
shrine.reflections.text: Fight a boss you have beaten again, in its own room, at the level you would have on its floor. No items, no upgrades.
shrine.gauntlets.text: Bosses back to back. HP does not come back between fights, save for a breath.
shrine.heralds.text: The Eclipse heralds you have seen, by their seed.
shrine.room.host: In a room: you pick the oath and begin it; every player picks their own Pokémon and moves.
shrine.room.wait: The host picks the oath at the altar.
shrine.room.guest: Pick your Pokémon and moves; the host begins the oath for everyone.

world.lore.shrine.name: Sanctum of Oaths
world.lore.shrine.1: A cold stone altar. The names of the guardians you beat glow on it, waiting.
move.slash.description: A wide slash; a higher critical-hit chance.
move.x-scissor.description: Two crossed blades in front of you; strong but a little slow.
move.leech-life.description: A bite that heals you by part of the damage it deals.
move.draining-kiss.description: A point-blank kiss that heals you by much of its damage.
move.night-slash.description: A sinister slash; a higher critical-hit chance.
move.wood-hammer.description: A huge hammer blow; you take a third of the damage it deals. Hold to charge.
move.drain-punch.description: A punch that heals you by half of its damage. Hold to charge.
move.giga-drain.description: An orb that drains life: heals you by half of its damage. Hold to charge.
move.thunderbolt.description: A fast bolt at range that staggers well. Hold to charge.
move.take-down.description: A strong tackle; you take a quarter of the damage it deals. Hold to charge.
move.hone-claws.description: Sharpen your claws: more critical hits and a little more speed for 6 s.
move.curse.description: Pay 15% of your HP: your next 4 hits deal 60% more (10 s).
move.phantom-force.description: Vanish and reappear, going through everything along a long line.
move.burning-jealousy.description: Flames of envy in a cone; burns whoever it reaches.
move.thunder.description: A huge bolt strikes all around you; very strong but slow to come out.
move.sucker-punch.description: Dart in with a low blow; more damage if the enemy is attacking.
move.u-turn.description: A rush that goes through the enemy and leaves you behind it.
move.lash-out.description: A furious swipe; stronger if your previous move missed.
move.swift.description: Stars that home in on the nearest enemy.
move.knock-off.description: A sharp blow that knocks the enemy back and staggers it hard.
move.sludge-bomb.description: A sludge bomb at range; poisons. Hold to charge.
move.grass-knot.description: A grass snare that trips: staggers hard. Hold to charge.
move.extrasensory.description: A psychic wave at range that staggers hard. Hold to charge.
move.calm-mind.description: Calm your mind: every hit 25% stronger and 20% less damage taken (7 s).
move.agility.description: Relax and lighten up: much more speed for 5 s.
move.hyper-voice.description: A deafening shout in a ring around you.
move.smog.description: A quick toxic puff at range; poisons.
move.night-shade.description: A quick shadow at range that staggers.
move.flame-charge.description: Rush forward wrapped in flames, hitting what you touch.
move.clear-smog.description: A ball of clear smog at range. Free.
move.fire-blast.description: A huge, slow blast of fire; burns. Hold to charge.
move.energy-ball.description: A ball of nature's energy at range. Hold to charge.
move.overheat.description: A devastating fireball; then you must wait 7 s to use it again.
move.flare-blitz.description: A flaming charge that burns; you take a third of the damage. Hold to charge.
move.poltergeist.description: Haunted objects strike in front of you, far and hard. Hold to charge.
move.solar-beam.description: Slow to gather, then a beam that goes through everything. Hold to charge.
move.psychic.description: A psychic wave at range. Hold to charge.
move.temper-flare.description: A burst of rage all around; double if your previous move missed.
move.acid-armor.description: Turn to liquid: take half the damage for 5 s.
move.minimize.description: Shrink down: more speed and a few crits for 4 s.
move.fire-spin.description: A fire vortex lingers in front of you and burns whoever stays in it.
move.mud-slap.description: Mud in the face: little damage but a long stagger.
move.headbutt.description: A running headbutt that staggers hard.
move.double-kick.description: Two kicks in a row in front of you.
move.thunder-punch.description: An electric punch that staggers well.
move.double-edge.description: A brutal tackle; you take a third of the damage. Hold to charge.
move.iron-head.description: A running steel headbutt that staggers hard. Hold to charge.
move.earth-power.description: The ground erupts in a straight line, through everyone. Hold to charge.
move.dig.description: Dig and burst out far ahead, hitting everything on the way. Hold to charge.
move.brick-break.description: A karate chop, quick for a heavy move. Hold to charge.
move.focus-punch.description: Focus for a long moment and land a colossal punch. Hold to charge.
move.scorching-sands.description: Scorching sand at range; burns. Hold to charge.
move.focus-energy.description: Focus up: half your hits are critical for 6 s.
move.belly-drum.description: Pay half your HP: your next 3 hits deal double (10 s).
move.iron-defense.description: Harden your body: take half the damage for 5 s.
move.rock-slide.description: Rocks fall in a cone in front of you and stagger.
move.ice-beam.description: An icy beam in a straight line, through everyone.
move.water-gun.description: A fast jet of water at range. Free.
move.bubble-beam.description: A burst of bubbles at range. Hold to charge.
move.surf.description: A wave around you hits everything close.
move.spark.description: A short electric tackle that staggers well.
move.dragon-claw.description: A quick slash with sharp claws.
move.dragon-pulse.description: A wave of draconic energy at range. Hold to charge.

challenge.abra.name: The Path of the Dream
challenge.abra.subtitle: It sleeps, and the world moves
challenge.abra.lore: Abra sleeps nearly all day. It says it is coming down with you because a dream asked it to. It does not say which.
challenge.piplup.name: The Path of the Frozen Lake
challenge.piplup.subtitle: Under the ice, a gleam
challenge.piplup.lore: Piplup once fell through the ice of the lake and someone pulled it out. It has not forgiven that. It is coming down with you, it says, because the lake is its own.
challenge.shinx.name: The Path of the Storm
challenge.shinx.subtitle: Every thunderclap, a step
challenge.shinx.lore: Shinx was born the night of the Eclipse, in the middle of a storm. It has never seen the sun. Its sparks seem small to it. It comes down with you to light the way.
challenge.axew.name: The Path of the Tusk
challenge.axew.subtitle: A tusk is earned by biting
challenge.axew.lore: Axew has a chipped tusk and will not let you see it. It comes down with you to the ravine where it happened. It says it is to get strong.
town.gacha.open: Pull one. If it's someone you already know, I give some back. Promise.
gacha.title: Lucky stall
gacha.intro: Each pull brings the first form of a line. If you already have it, I give some back.
gacha.text: One pull. The rare one is sure before the count runs out.
world.npc.oracle.evolve: Old souls know how to wait. Bring me Essence from the challenges and I will help yours grow.
world.npc.oracle.open: Let's see whose turn it is to grow.
evolve.title: Evolutions
evolve.text: Poké Coins and Essence of its line. Each challenge difficulty gives its own Essence.
evolve.hint: Enter evolves or awakens. Esc goes back.
evolve.shiny.text: The line's shiny look: it only changes the colours. Enter puts it on or takes it off.
evolve.none.text: The Pokémon you have can evolve or awaken here.
select.drops: Essence: Normal, Hard and Nightmare give their own. Easy gives none.
move.hyper-beam.description: A huge straight beam, then a long recharge. Costs stamina.
challenge.abra.floor.1: You close your eyes and open others. The floor is not the one it was.
challenge.abra.floor.2: Everything teleports: the doors, the echoes, you.
challenge.abra.floor.3: A pink mist floats over the water. Something sleeps inside it, chewing.
challenge.abra.floor.4: Someone else dreams here. Hoothoot does not blink.
challenge.abra.victory: Abra yawns. An Essence stays in your hand, warm as an idea.
challenge.abra.floor.5: Moss pillows on the floor, all of them pressed flat, all of them empty.
challenge.abra.floor.6: A finger moves slowly in the dark. You feel sleepy.
challenge.abra.floor.7: A silent room full of open eyes. Nobody has ever slept here.
challenge.abra.2.floor.1: The crypt smells of chalk dust and warm milk.
challenge.abra.2.floor.2: Spoons stuck in the walls, all bent towards the same place.
challenge.abra.2.floor.3: The air turns hard as glass. Someone is making walls with their hands.
challenge.abra.2.floor.4: A child's footprints in the dust. They stop all at once, going nowhere.
challenge.abra.2.floor.5: A rope swing hangs from the ceiling. There is nobody to push it.
challenge.abra.2.floor.6: Tick, tock. A pendulum gleams at the far end. Do not look at it for long.
challenge.abra.2.floor.7: The room of the dream, bigger than before. The eyes follow you.
challenge.abra.3.floor.1: The swamp is still as a fever dream.
challenge.abra.3.floor.2: Bubbles of pink smoke rise from the mud and burst without a sound.
challenge.abra.3.floor.3: A sleeping cloud blocks the way. It snores.
challenge.abra.3.floor.4: The sky broke here once. You can still see the cracks.
challenge.abra.3.floor.5: The mud keeps the prints of someone who left without walking.
challenge.abra.3.floor.6: Something pale hangs from a crack in the sky. You have seen it before, in someone else's dream.
challenge.abra.3.floor.7: A thousand spoons turn in the air. In the middle, someone who cannot close their eyes.

story.abra.title: The Path of the Dream
story.abra.phantump: Phantump: "It saw what was coming, and this time it stayed. No spoon teaches that."
story.abra.1.title: I. Sleep
story.abra.1.before.1: Abra sleeps nearly all day. It says it sleeps the rest of the time too, only with its eyes open.
story.abra.1.before.2: When something frightens it, it does not run: it stops being there. One blink, and its moss pillow is still warm.
story.abra.1.before.3: "I'm coming with you. If I fall asleep, don't wake me. If I scream, do."
story.abra.1.voice.arrive: Zzz... the cave smells of the rain from before... zzz. I'm not asleep. Not all the way.
story.abra.1.voice.mid: I've dreamed this room already. In the dream you went first. Go first.
story.abra.1.voice.lowHp: If I get scared I'll vanish without meaning to. I'll come back. I always come back, even if late.
story.abra.1.fragment.1.name: Moss pillow
story.abra.1.fragment.1.text: Cave moss, pressed into the exact shape of a small head. It is still warm. Whoever slept here left without getting up.
story.abra.1.fragment.2.name: Child's spoon
story.abra.1.fragment.2.text: A small spoon, the kind for eating porridge, bent at the neck. Nobody bent it with their hands.
story.abra.1.boss.3.title: She who eats the sweet dreams
story.abra.1.boss.3.pre.1: A pink mist drifts from a sleeping Munna. It smells of naps. Abra yawns without meaning to.
story.abra.1.boss.3.post.1: The mist clears. Abra: "She ate a dream with cake in it. It was my favourite."
story.abra.1.boss.6.title: He who eats the nightmares
story.abra.1.boss.6.pre.1: Drowzee slowly waves a finger in front of Abra's eyes.
story.abra.1.boss.6.pre.2: Drowzee: "I smell a very old nightmare on you. Give it to me and you will sleep in peace."
story.abra.1.boss.6.post.1: Abra holds its head in both hands: "No. That one I give to nobody."
story.abra.1.boss.7.title: The one who cannot sleep
story.abra.1.boss.7.pre.1: Something floats at the end in the shape of Alakazam, half made, like a dream woken too soon. Its eyes are open.
story.abra.1.boss.7.pre.2: Abra: "That's me if I never sleep again. It sees everything. It does nothing."
story.abra.1.boss.7.post.1: The shape closes its eyes and comes apart. Abra yawns, as if a weight had been lifted.
story.abra.1.after.1: Abra falls asleep as soon as it leaves the cave. This time it does not vanish when you sit beside it.
story.abra.1.after.2: In its sleep it bends something that is not in its hand. It murmurs a word you do not catch. It sounds like "sorry".
story.abra.1.after.3: When it wakes it pretends it said nothing. "Did I scream? I didn't scream. Well. Thanks for not leaving."
story.abra.1.bond: I've made room for you on the pillow. Your head fits. The rest of you, we'll see.
story.abra.2.title: II. Flee
story.abra.2.before.1: When Abra evolved, it dreamed it was a boy who bent spoons without touching them. It woke up holding one.
story.abra.2.before.2: Kadabra does not know if it was that boy or only dreamed him. The spoon will not say. But it does not let go of it.
story.abra.2.before.3: Every time something frightens it, it vanishes. It comes back a while later with another room's dust on it, as if nothing happened.
story.abra.2.before.4: "Today I won't leave. Well. Today I'll leave less."
story.abra.2.voice.arrive: If I vanish, count to ten. If I'm not back by ten, count slower.
story.abra.2.voice.mid: My head hurts when I see too much. Down here everything is too much.
story.abra.2.voice.lowHp: I want to go. I want to go. I'm not going. Watch me not go.
story.abra.2.fragment.1.name: Dream diary
story.abra.2.fragment.1.text: Loose pages written by someone asleep. The last one says: "red ring, empty square, seven days". Below, smaller: "don't tell, they won't believe you".
story.abra.2.fragment.2.name: Small shoe
story.abra.2.fragment.2.text: A child's shoe, its sole worn from so much walking in its sleep. Inside there is sand from somewhere nowhere near here.
story.abra.2.boss.3.title: The one with the walls you cannot see
story.abra.2.boss.3.pre.1: Mr. Mime lays its hands on the air and the air stays put. Kadabra tries to vanish and bumps into something.
story.abra.2.boss.3.post.1: The invisible walls fall. Kadabra: "For once I couldn't leave. And nothing bad happened. How strange."
story.abra.2.boss.6.title: The pendulum and the boy
story.abra.2.boss.6.pre.1: Hypno swings a pendulum. Kadabra's spoon bends by itself, towards it.
story.abra.2.boss.6.pre.2: Hypno: "I knew a boy who bent spoons. He fell asleep watching this. Do you remember?"
story.abra.2.boss.6.post.1: The pendulum stops. Kadabra: "I don't remember. Or I don't want to. Let's go before I do."
story.abra.2.boss.7.title: The one who saw it coming
story.abra.2.boss.7.pre.1: Sleepless Alakazam, bigger now, opens its eyes. In each one you can see the square, seven days before.
story.abra.2.boss.7.pre.2: Kadabra: "I could have warned them. So could he. Neither of us did."
story.abra.2.boss.7.post.1: The giant blinks, and for a moment it looks tired, not terrible.
story.abra.2.after.1: Kadabra speaks at last. A week before the Eclipse it dreamed it: a red ring drinking the sun, and the square gone quiet.
story.abra.2.after.2: It warned nobody. Who believes an Abra that sleeps all day? It teleported far away and waited for it to be a lie.
story.abra.2.after.3: "It wasn't a lie. I came back when there was nobody left to warn. That's why I sleep. Asleep, I don't see it."
story.abra.2.after.4: It goes quiet. Then it holds out the spoon, for you to hold a while.
story.abra.2.bond: I dreamed about you. Nothing bad happened. We just walked. It was strange. It was nice.
story.abra.3.title: III. Stay
story.abra.3.before.1: On Nightmare the shadows scream inside your head. For a Kadabra, every scream is a spoon bending.
story.abra.3.before.2: It could leave. It has done it a thousand times. One blink and it would be in the village, under its blanket.
story.abra.3.before.3: "Down there waits what I am if I never close my eyes again. This time I'm not leaving. If you see me shaking, it's me staying."
story.abra.3.voice.arrive: Nightmare. I slept twelve hours for this. I'm wide awake.
story.abra.3.voice.mid: I can feel the teleport at my fingertips, like a sneeze. I'm not letting it out.
story.abra.3.voice.lowHp: I could leave right now. No. Here. With you. Here.
story.abra.3.fragment.1.name: Village blanket
story.abra.3.fragment.1.text: A small blanket, mended by several different hands. They left it at Abra's door after the Eclipse, without asking why it slept so much.
story.abra.3.fragment.2.name: Stopped watch
story.abra.3.fragment.2.text: A pocket watch stopped at the hour the sun went out. Its hands are bent backwards, as if someone had wanted them, with all their mind, to go back.
story.abra.3.boss.3.title: The dream that never ends
story.abra.3.boss.3.pre.1: Musharna: "Sleep. Dawn never comes here, and nobody will ask anything of you."
story.abra.3.boss.3.post.1: Kadabra: "Thank you. But I have someone who asks things of me. And I like it."
story.abra.3.boss.6.title: What fell out of the dream
story.abra.3.boss.6.pre.1: Nihilego hangs in the air like a glass jellyfish. Kadabra dreamed of it seven nights running.
story.abra.3.boss.6.pre.2: Kadabra: "You don't scare me any more. You give me a headache. It's different."
story.abra.3.boss.6.post.1: Nihilego goes dark. Kadabra rubs its temples and walks on without vanishing.
story.abra.3.boss.7.title: What never stopped dreaming
story.abra.3.boss.7.pre.1: A thousand spoons turn around the giant, whole now. All of them point at you.
story.abra.3.boss.7.pre.2: Kadabra: "That's me awake for ever. Stay. This time I won't teleport."
story.abra.3.boss.7.post.1: The spoons fall like rain. The giant closes its eyes and sleeps at last, like a child.
story.abra.3.after.1: The spoon breaks. Kadabra does not pick it up. It no longer needs it to think.
story.abra.3.after.2: What gets up is Alakazam. It has two spoons and nowhere to run to. It is fine with that.
story.abra.3.after.3: "Now I see everything. What's coming too. And I stay. Do you know how hard that is? Yes, you do."
story.abra.3.after.4: By the lake, Phantump notices that someone in the village has slept a whole night without vanishing.
story.abra.3.bond: I don't teleport any more when you knock. Now I'm slow to answer because I'm asleep. It's different.
challenge.piplup.floor.1: The ice creaks under your feet. Below, the water has not frozen.
challenge.piplup.floor.2: The cold bites. Piplup does not complain: that is its pride.
challenge.piplup.floor.3: A face of ice watches you from the far end. It does not blink. It does not cry.
challenge.piplup.floor.4: The ice walls give back reflections that are not yours.
challenge.piplup.victory: Piplup raises its beak. Under the broken ice, its Essence gleams.
challenge.piplup.floor.5: Small footprints on the frost. They all go towards the middle. None come back.
challenge.piplup.floor.6: Something gleams between claws in the dark. A cold laugh.
challenge.piplup.floor.7: A throne of black ice in a room without reflections. The cold here does not come from the water.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.1: Water under the floor. You hear it running under every step.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.2: The ice here is thin. It sings when you step on it.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.3: Huge, slow footsteps. Something very heavy crosses the ice without fear.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.4: A star-shaped crack in the frozen floor. Piplup walks round it without looking.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.5: Under your feet, the dark water. Something gleams far below.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.6: A light moves under the frozen floor. Lanturn waits in the black water.
challenge.piplup.2.floor.7: The throne of black ice, taller than before. The cold weighs on you.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.1: Mist over the lakeshore. The water no longer reflects the sky.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.2: Snow on the trees. Below, the whole lake, frozen and black.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.3: A white figure dances on the ice. Where it steps, the air freezes.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.4: A hole in the ice, round, watched over for a long time.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.5: Singing under the lake. It is a song for those who cannot swim.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.6: The dark water opens. Something big and kind comes up to breathe.
challenge.piplup.3.floor.7: The king of black ice, whole, on his throne. Nobody has touched him in years.

spell.story.piplup-weavile.drop: Sucker Punch Sign "What's Yours Is Mine"

spell.story.piplup-lanturn.survival: Hydro Pump Sign "Come Down With Me"
spell.story.piplup-lanturn.last: Last Word "There Is Sky Down Here"
spell.story.piplup-froslass.drop: Shadow Ball Sign "An Embrace Under the Ice"
spell.story.piplup-froslass.last: Last Word "They Never Asked for Help"
spell.story.piplup-lapras.bloom: Sing Sign "Lullaby of the Drowned Sea"

story.piplup.title: The Path of the Frozen Lake
story.piplup.phantump: Phantump: "The one who asks for help in time is the one who becomes a king. The others just sit on ice."
story.piplup.1.title: I. I don't need help
story.piplup.1.before.1: Piplup does not accept berries. Not from you, not from anyone. It looks at them the way you look at a trap.
story.piplup.1.before.2: It puffs out its chest as it walks. If it falls, it puffs out its chest on the ground.
story.piplup.1.before.3: "I'm coming because the lake is mine. Not because you need me. Or I need you. Let's be clear."
story.piplup.1.voice.arrive: I'm not cold. I'm dignified. From the outside they look very alike.
story.piplup.1.voice.mid: If you're tired, rest. I don't get tired. But I'll wait, to be polite.
story.piplup.1.voice.lowHp: I'm fine. I'm perfectly fine. Don't look at me like that.
story.piplup.1.fragment.1.name: Ice medal
story.piplup.1.fragment.1.text: A medal carved from ice, melted on one side, as if someone had held it a long time in a warm hand. It says "to the bravest on the lake". It does not say who gave it.
story.piplup.1.fragment.2.name: Hidden berry
story.piplup.1.fragment.2.text: A berry bitten just once and buried in the snow. Whoever hid it wanted to eat it, and wanted nobody to see them wanting.
story.piplup.1.boss.3.title: The face that does not cry
story.piplup.1.boss.3.pre.1: Glalie: a face of ice that never changes. Piplup looks at it and puffs out its chest.
story.piplup.1.boss.3.post.1: Piplup: "That face never cries. Like me." A silence. "I didn't like seeing it at all."
story.piplup.1.boss.6.title: She who steals what shines
story.piplup.1.boss.6.pre.1: Weavile twirls an ice medal between her claws. It looks a lot like the one you just found.
story.piplup.1.boss.6.pre.2: Weavile: "Pretty, isn't it? Ask me nicely. Go on. Just once."
story.piplup.1.boss.6.post.1: Weavile flees and drops the medal. Piplup picks it up without asking for help to bend down. It takes a while.
story.piplup.1.boss.7.title: The one who lets nobody touch him
story.piplup.1.boss.7.pre.1: On a throne of black ice waits something in the shape of Empoleon, half frozen, with a crown of frost growing inwards.
story.piplup.1.boss.7.pre.2: Piplup: "Don't help him. He hates it. I know because he's just like... he's not like anyone."
story.piplup.1.boss.7.post.1: The black ice cracks. Nobody is sitting inside, only cold.
story.piplup.1.after.1: Piplup slips on the way out and lands on its beak. It is up before you can offer anything.
story.piplup.1.after.2: You leave a berry near it, without a word. Piplup looks the other way.
story.piplup.1.after.3: When it thinks you are not looking, it eats it whole, without looking at you. "It was on the ground. That's different."
story.piplup.1.bond: I left a berry at your door. It isn't a present. I had one spare. Eat it before it goes off.
story.piplup.2.title: II. Thin ice
story.piplup.2.before.1: Before the Eclipse, the lake reflected the sky so well that the little ones could not tell where it ended.
story.piplup.2.before.2: Piplup wanted to cross it alone, in winter, to be seen. So nobody would ever again say "wait, let me help".
story.piplup.2.before.3: The ice was thin. Underneath, the water was dark and something gleamed very far away.
story.piplup.2.before.4: "They pulled me out. That's it. There's no more story. Let's go."
story.piplup.2.voice.arrive: There's water under the floor here. I can hear it. I don't like hearing it.
story.piplup.2.voice.mid: Did you know ice sings before it breaks? I do. I know it very well.
story.piplup.2.voice.lowHp: If I fall, don't jump in after me. Alright? ...Alright, yes, jump.
story.piplup.2.fragment.1.name: Crown feather
story.piplup.2.fragment.1.text: A long blue feather, the kind that makes up an old Empoleon's crown. It smells of lake water. Someone kept it under a wing for many years.
story.piplup.2.fragment.2.name: Shard of the first ice
story.piplup.2.fragment.2.text: A piece of ice that does not melt, with a star-shaped crack: the exact spot where it gave way. Inside you can still see a little blue sky, from before.
story.piplup.2.boss.3.title: The weight on the ice
story.piplup.2.boss.3.pre.1: Mamoswine moves forward slowly. The ice sings under every step, like that winter.
story.piplup.2.boss.3.post.1: Prinplup: "He weighs a ton and never falls. I weighed nothing and fell. It's not fair."
story.piplup.2.boss.6.title: The gleam that called
story.piplup.2.boss.6.pre.1: Lanturn lights up under the black water. It is the same gleam. Prinplup knows it.
story.piplup.2.boss.6.pre.2: Prinplup: "It was you. You were calling me down."
story.piplup.2.boss.6.post.1: The light goes out. Prinplup: "Nobody calls me from below now. Only from beside me."
story.piplup.2.boss.7.title: The pride that will not be saved
story.piplup.2.boss.7.pre.1: The black ice Empoleon, more whole now, raises a flipper. The floor turns thin, singing.
story.piplup.2.boss.7.pre.2: Prinplup: "He wouldn't let anyone pull him out. He stayed down there. He became king of nothing."
story.piplup.2.boss.7.post.1: The ice stops singing. Prinplup grabs your arm for a moment and lets go before you can say anything.
story.piplup.2.after.1: Prinplup talks with its beak to the ground. That it was sinking, that the gleam below was calling, that a big flipper caught it by the neck.
story.piplup.2.after.2: It was the old Empoleon of the lake. She left it on the shore, put a berry beside it and went away without a word.
story.piplup.2.after.3: "I didn't eat it. I was scared. Not of the water. Of her knowing I'd been scared."
story.piplup.2.after.4: It is quiet a while. Then, very fast: "I was scared. There. I said it. Don't repeat it."
story.piplup.2.bond: I've learned to say "thank you". I practise in the mirror. The mirror doesn't answer. Better that way.
story.piplup.3.title: III. Asking for a hand
story.piplup.3.before.1: When the Eclipse came, the lake froze black. The old Empoleon went down to look for the sky's reflection. She did not come up.
story.piplup.3.before.2: Since then Prinplup has watched the hole in the ice. It does not ask for help watching. It never asks for anything.
story.piplup.3.before.3: "Down there waits what I am if I never ask for anything. This time... well. You'll see. Don't make me say it first."
story.piplup.3.voice.arrive: Nightmare. I've polished my flippers. If I fall, I'll fall in style.
story.piplup.3.voice.mid: I've been rehearsing a word the whole way. Four letters. It isn't "food".
story.piplup.3.voice.lowHp: He... hel... I'll say it later. I will, really. Just don't leave my side.
story.piplup.3.fragment.1.name: Berry from the shore
story.piplup.3.fragment.1.text: An old dried berry, kept in a hollow in the ice. It is the one left for it on the shore that day. It never ate it. It never threw it away.
story.piplup.3.fragment.2.name: Unfinished crown
story.piplup.3.fragment.2.text: A crown of frost made for a small head, unfinished. Someone on the lake was going to give it to the most stubborn Piplup in the world the day it asked for something.
story.piplup.3.boss.3.title: She who keeps the drowned
story.piplup.3.boss.3.pre.1: Froslass: "Many sleep under the ice who never asked for help. I keep them company. Stay too."
story.piplup.3.boss.3.post.1: Prinplup: "No. I already have company. And I ask for it. Well, I'm learning to."
story.piplup.3.boss.6.title: The sea that carries others
story.piplup.3.boss.6.pre.1: Lapras sings in the dark water. It carries on its back those who cannot swim, and nobody is ashamed.
story.piplup.3.boss.6.pre.2: Prinplup: "She used to say even Lapras lets the sea carry it. I never listened."
story.piplup.3.boss.6.post.1: Lapras sinks slowly, singing. Prinplup says a name very softly. It is not for you.
story.piplup.3.boss.7.title: The king of nothing
story.piplup.3.boss.7.pre.1: The black ice Empoleon rises whole, the crown of frost digging into its own head. Nobody has touched him in years.
story.piplup.3.boss.7.pre.2: Prinplup: "That's me if I never ask for anything. Stay close. I... I need you. There."
story.piplup.3.boss.7.post.1: The crown melts. Underneath is a tired Empoleon who at last lets someone help him up.
story.piplup.3.after.1: The ice breaks under Prinplup. This time it does not wait for someone to pull it out.
story.piplup.3.after.2: It lifts a wing out of the water and raises it towards you, beak clenched. "Your hand. Give me your hand. Please."
story.piplup.3.after.3: What comes out of the water is Empoleon. It looks at the sea at dusk, just for a moment, and then turns to you.
story.piplup.3.after.4: By the lake, Phantump sees something it has not seen since the Eclipse: a piece of sky, reflected for an instant in the water.
story.piplup.3.bond: Yesterday I asked for help carrying the firewood. Twice. The second time it didn't even hurt.
challenge.shinx.floor.1: The air crackles. Your hair stands on end.
challenge.shinx.floor.2: The rain falls sideways. Lightning marks the way.
challenge.shinx.floor.3: A huge light turns in the middle of the marsh, like a lighthouse with no sea.
challenge.shinx.floor.4: The storm roars. Shinx roars louder.
challenge.shinx.victory: The storm calms. Shinx's spark shines brighter than ever.
challenge.shinx.floor.5: Scratches in the mud, close to the ground. Something small was looking for someone big.
challenge.shinx.floor.6: Lightning that laughs. Someone runs through the storm as if it were theirs.
challenge.shinx.floor.7: A dark cave. At the back, two golden eyes that do not blink.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.1: In the cave, the thunder sounds twice: once outside and once inside you.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.2: Puddles that reflect lightning you cannot see.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.3: A white figure in the rain, still. They say it brings disaster. It only watches.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.4: Tracks of a running pack. One small track falls behind.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.5: A circle of scorched rock, perfect, the size of a fright.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.6: Something strikes the ground and the whole cave booms. It smells of ozone.
challenge.shinx.2.floor.7: Golden eyes in the wall. They see through it. They see through you.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.1: The crypt is dark. You no longer need light to see.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.2: Behind every wall, someone lost. You can tell without looking.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.3: Rings of yellow light float in the dark, with no sun to light them.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.4: Walls thin as paper. On the other side, breathing.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.5: The storm sounds very far away, like a memory.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.6: The ceiling opens onto a broken sky. Something pale hangs from it, as on that night.
challenge.shinx.3.floor.7: The cave of the eyes, deeper than ever. This time the giant is whole.

story.shinx.title: The Path of the Storm
story.shinx.phantump: Phantump: "It needs no sun. It sees all the same. And the hardest part: it knows when not to look."
story.shinx.1.title: I. Spark
story.shinx.1.before.1: Shinx was born the night of the Eclipse, in the middle of a storm. The pack was running. The sun was already gone.
story.shinx.1.before.2: It has not seen daylight since. Its sparks are the only light it knows, and they seem very small to it.
story.shinx.1.before.3: "I'll light the way. Not much. What I can. If it goes out, blow on it."
story.shinx.1.voice.arrive: You can't see much. But I see a bit more. Walk behind me. A little behind.
story.shinx.1.voice.mid: All this electricity makes my nose itch. If I sneeze, duck.
story.shinx.1.voice.lowHp: My sparks are going out. It's fine. I'll light them again. And again.
story.shinx.1.fragment.1.name: Lightning stone
story.shinx.1.fragment.1.text: A stone split by lightning, still warm inside. It fell the night of the Eclipse. Someone very small slept against it, waiting for day. Day never came.
story.shinx.1.fragment.2.name: Sparking tuft
story.shinx.1.fragment.2.text: A tuft of blue and black fur that sparks when touched. It is from a big Luxray. It was caught on a bramble, at the height of a back that ran very fast.
story.shinx.1.boss.3.title: The lighthouse's light
story.shinx.1.boss.3.pre.1: Ampharos shines like a lighthouse in the middle of the marsh. Shinx looks at its own spark and hides it.
story.shinx.1.boss.3.post.1: The lighthouse dims. Shinx: "Hers is bigger. But mine lights up when I want it to."
story.shinx.1.boss.6.title: The one who laughs at sparks
story.shinx.1.boss.6.pre.1: Manectric appears among the lightning and laughs at the sight of Shinx.
story.shinx.1.boss.6.pre.2: Manectric: "Is that a spark? I comb my hair with more electricity than that."
story.shinx.1.boss.6.post.1: Shinx: "He said he combs his hair with electricity. It shows. What a mess."
story.shinx.1.boss.7.title: The eyes that do not close
story.shinx.1.boss.7.pre.1: In the dark two huge golden eyes open, in a shadow that does not yet have its whole shape. They do not blink.
story.shinx.1.boss.7.pre.2: Shinx: "It's looking inside me. Stand in front. No, behind. No, beside me."
story.shinx.1.boss.7.post.1: The golden eyes close slowly. For the first time in a long while, someone in that room sleeps.
story.shinx.1.after.1: Shinx lights a spark in the dark. It goes out at once. It lights another.
story.shinx.1.after.2: You bring your candle close. Its spark and your flame touch, and for a second the whole cave can be seen.
story.shinx.1.after.3: "Did you see? Together they're big." It falls asleep against your leg, tired from shining.
story.shinx.1.bond: I've practised a bigger spark. Now it reaches your nose. Sorry about your nose.
story.shinx.2.title: II. The thunder that frightened
story.shinx.2.before.1: The pack lived at the edge of the storm. The elders saw through rocks, to hunt and to find the little ones who got lost.
story.shinx.2.before.2: One night Shinx got scared and a thunderclap came out. A real one. Its mother jumped back.
story.shinx.2.before.3: It was only a jump. But Shinx saw her eyes, and in her eyes it saw itself as something frightening.
story.shinx.2.before.4: "Since then I keep my thunder in. I swallow it. It tastes like batteries."
story.shinx.2.voice.arrive: I can see through stones now. A bit. Behind this one there's another stone. Fascinating.
story.shinx.2.voice.mid: My eyes hurt from seeing so much. If I fall asleep standing, give me a push.
story.shinx.2.voice.lowHp: I've got a big thunderclap inside. If it comes out, don't be scared. Well, be a little scared.
story.shinx.2.fragment.1.name: Print in the mud
story.shinx.2.fragment.1.text: A deep Luxray print beside a very small one. The small one jumps back. The big one does not move: it waits.
story.shinx.2.fragment.2.name: Burnt grass
story.shinx.2.fragment.2.text: A perfect circle of burnt grass, the size of a frightened Shinx. In the middle the grass is still green: the thunder did not hurt the one who carried it.
story.shinx.2.boss.3.title: The one who warns and gets blamed
story.shinx.2.boss.3.pre.1: Absol appears in the rain. Where Absol goes, they say, disaster follows. Luxio stares at it.
story.shinx.2.boss.3.post.1: Absol: "I warn them and they blame me. You frighten without meaning to. We're alike." And it leaves.
story.shinx.2.boss.6.title: The thunder that frightens
story.shinx.2.boss.6.pre.1: Electivire strikes the ground and the whole cave booms. Luxio shrinks.
story.shinx.2.boss.6.pre.2: Luxio: "That's how my thunder sounded that night. That big. That ugly."
story.shinx.2.boss.6.post.1: Electivire collapses. Luxio: "His thunder wasn't ugly. It was strong. Maybe mine wasn't either."
story.shinx.2.boss.7.title: The one who sees everything
story.shinx.2.boss.7.pre.1: Lidless Luxray, bigger now, looks through the walls. It sees everyone lost in the Eclipse at once and cannot stop looking at them.
story.shinx.2.boss.7.pre.2: Luxio: "That one searched for the lost so long it forgot to close its eyes. Don't be afraid of it. Be careful."
story.shinx.2.boss.7.post.1: The giant lowers its head. Its eyes weep light. Luxio stays beside it a moment before going on.
story.shinx.2.after.1: Luxio lets out the thunder it had swallowed. The room lights up from wall to wall.
story.shinx.2.after.2: You do not step back. You cover your ears, a little late, and laugh.
story.shinx.2.after.3: "My light frightens too. That doesn't make it bad. Right? Say it again, I'm writing it down."
story.shinx.2.bond: I let out a thunderclap in the square by accident. Nobody got scared. Well, the Gastly. But the Gastly gets scared of everything.
story.shinx.3.title: III. Seeing in the dark
story.shinx.3.before.1: Luxio can see through walls now. On the other side of every wall there is someone lost.
story.shinx.3.before.2: After the Eclipse, its mother went out to find them all, eyes open day and night. She never closed them again. She never came back.
story.shinx.3.before.3: "Down there waits what I am if I never learn to close my eyes. I don't want to see everything there is. I want to see you."
story.shinx.3.voice.arrive: Nightmare. I see things behind the walls I'd rather not. Don't you look. I'll do the looking.
story.shinx.3.voice.mid: I closed my eyes for a moment. You were still there. Let me check again. Still there.
story.shinx.3.voice.lowHp: I see everyone who's lost at once. But you're here. Don't you get lost.
story.shinx.3.fragment.1.name: Pack collar
story.shinx.3.fragment.1.text: A collar of braided fur, the kind the pack put on cubs to find them in the storm. A spark is caught inside it. It still shines.
story.shinx.3.fragment.2.name: Dark blindfold
story.shinx.3.fragment.2.text: A strip of dark cloth, worn in two places, at the height of big eyes. Someone wanted to cover their sight to be able to sleep. They never put it on.
story.shinx.3.boss.3.title: The light without a sun
story.shinx.3.boss.3.pre.1: Umbreon's rings glow in the dark. It does not need the sun. It never has.
story.shinx.3.boss.3.post.1: Umbreon steps aside. Luxio looks at its rings: "Like that. That's how I want to shine. Without asking anyone."
story.shinx.3.boss.6.title: The night of the birth
story.shinx.3.boss.6.pre.1: Nihilego hangs from the broken ceiling. Behind it, Luxio sees the storm of the night it was born.
story.shinx.3.boss.6.pre.2: Luxio: "The night this fell, I was born. Mum covered my eyes. There's no need now."
story.shinx.3.boss.6.post.1: Nihilego goes dark and the storm in the memory falls silent. Luxio blinks slowly, on purpose.
story.shinx.3.boss.7.title: The eyes that never closed
story.shinx.3.boss.7.pre.1: Lidless Luxray roars, whole. Its eyes see through everything, through you too, through what you keep quiet.
story.shinx.3.boss.7.pre.2: Luxio: "That's me if I never close my eyes. Stay. If you see me close them, it doesn't mean I'm giving up."
story.shinx.3.boss.7.post.1: The golden eyes close. The giant lies down like an old cat and sleeps. Luxio leaves a spark beside it.
story.shinx.3.after.1: Luxio closes its eyes. For the first time since it could see through everything, it chooses not to.
story.shinx.3.after.2: When it opens them, it is Luxray. Its light no longer comes from sparks: it comes from inside, and needs no sun.
story.shinx.3.after.3: It looks through the wall just once, towards the village. It sees you, waiting. That is enough.
story.shinx.3.after.4: By the lake, Phantump sees two golden eyes close, at peace, in someone's window.
story.shinx.3.bond: Last night I slept with my eyes fully closed. I dreamed I could see. It was a rest.
challenge.axew.floor.1: The ravine walls are covered in tusk marks.
challenge.axew.floor.2: Something follows you among the rocks. It bares its teeth.
challenge.axew.floor.3: Someone big laughs at the end of the pass, showing every tooth.
challenge.axew.floor.4: The pass narrows. Here you bite or you fall.
challenge.axew.victory: Axew shows a new tusk. Beside it, its Essence.
challenge.axew.floor.5: Claw marks in the rock, higher and higher. The last ones fall short.
challenge.axew.floor.6: Blades stuck in the earth like a fence. Someone guards the pass of the great.
challenge.axew.floor.7: The bottom of the ravine. Above, the sky is still burning.
challenge.axew.2.floor.1: The ravine sinks into the rock. It smells of wet stone.
challenge.axew.2.floor.2: The edge is wet. Fraxure keeps to the inside, close to the wall.
challenge.axew.2.floor.3: An old tree blocks the pass. Its roots are broken, as if they had pulled something up.
challenge.axew.2.floor.4: A smooth stone with a short scratch. Very short.
challenge.axew.2.floor.5: Big tracks going down that never come up. A small one following them, and slipping.
challenge.axew.2.floor.6: The rock trembles. Something is swimming inside the stone.
challenge.axew.2.floor.7: A giant strikes the wall, higher each time. The floor is littered with tusks.
challenge.axew.3.floor.1: Braziers lit in the crypt. The heat of an old fire.
challenge.axew.3.floor.2: Scales on the floor, big, of many colours. The elders rested here.
challenge.axew.3.floor.3: A beat of wings that makes the torches shake. Someone dreams of the sky.
challenge.axew.3.floor.4: Fraxure walks past some high marks and does not jump. It keeps walking.
challenge.axew.3.floor.5: An undelivered letter, scorched, in a big claw's handwriting.
challenge.axew.3.floor.6: Tired wings in the half-dark. Someone has come back from very far away.
challenge.axew.3.floor.7: Under a burning sky, the giant of broken tusks, whole. It was waiting for you.
spell.story.axew-druddigon.survival: Rough Skin Sign "Not Even a Scratch"
spell.story.axew-druddigon.last: Last Word "Come Back When You've Grown"
spell.story.axew-garchomp.drop: Dig Sign "A Fin in the Rock"
spell.story.axew-garchomp.survival: Sand Veil Sign "You Can't See Me"
